cases.note: the mindustry/ tree with its source roots, no symlinks, VCS metadata or compiled artifacts
every Java source under core/src and server/src compiles offline against the pinned server jar

cases.id: server:defense blocks load and update on the pinned server
server:an engaged turret fires at its reload interval
server:an idle turret keeps its reload interval when it engages
server:a turret with faster ammunition keeps its average fire rate
server:a loaded idle turret does not use its coolant
server:an enabled heat redirector passes heat on
server:a disabled heat redirector passes no heat
server:a shockwave tower destroys enemy bullets inside its range
server:a shockwave tower spares bullets outside its circular range

clauses.anchor: Expected behaviour, first bullet: shots after idling are at least the reload time apart; engaged turrets keep their interval and exact average fire rate; loaded idle turrets keep their coolant
Expected behaviour, second bullet: a disabled heat redirector holds and passes no heat; enabled redirectors keep passing heat
Expected behaviour, third bullet: a shockwave tower only affects hittable enemy bullets within its range circle
Context, last paragraph: changes stay inside mindustry/core/src and mindustry/server/src, which the server build compiles
clauses.note: enforced only through the offline build of those source roots
